pipeline: ORBITALYTICS Phase 9 Resource Optimisation and Shortage Detection

scenario_meta.name: 1. Baseline Scenario
scenario_meta.description: Nominal Phase 8 forecast with authorized quarterly budgets and baseline cleanroom capacity.

scenario_meta.name: 2. High-Demand Scenario (95% Upper Bound)
scenario_meta.description: Upper 95% confidence interval demand surge (+10% to +15%) testing supply chain resilience.

scenario_meta.name: 3. Low-Demand Scenario (95% Lower Bound)
scenario_meta.description: Lower 95% confidence interval contraction evaluating surplus inventory holding risks.

scenario_meta.name: 4. Limited-Budget Scenario (-35% Austerity)
scenario_meta.description: Severe budgetary contraction (-35%) forcing optimal trade-offs and priority triage.

scenario_meta.name: 5. Increased-Production Scenario (+35% Capacity)
scenario_meta.description: Internal manufacturing expansion (+35% tooling capacity) testing make-vs-buy shift.

assumptions_documentation.cleanroom_tooling_capacity: 1200 total units per quarter across components
assumptions_documentation.holding_cost: 2.5% of unit procurement price per quarter
